# simplemdm_dep_devices (Data Source)

Lists DEP devices reported by the given Apple DEP server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplemdm_dep_devices" "all" {
  dep_server_id = "1"
}

output "serial_numbers" {
  value = [for d in data.simplemdm_dep_devices.all.dep_devices : d.serial_number]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dep_server_id` (String) Required. The DEP server ID whose devices to list.

### Read-Only

- `dep_devices` (Block List) Collection of DEP devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--dep_devices))

<a id="nestedblock--dep_devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dep_devices`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String) Reported device color.
- `description` (String) Reported device description.
- `device_assigned_by` (String) User or system that assigned the device.
- `device_assigned_date` (String) Date the device was assigned to the organization.
- `device_family` (String) Apple device family (iPhone, iPad, Mac…).
- `id` (String) DEP device ID.
- `model` (String) Apple device model.
- `os` (String) Operating system family.
- `profile_assign_time` (String) Timestamp when the device profile was assigned.
- `profile_push_time` (String) Timestamp when the profile was last pushed.
- `profile_status` (String) Current profile assignment status.
- `serial_number` (String) Serial number reported by Apple.
